# ghost/sgt-puzzles

Simon Tatham's Puzzles (F-Droid): open a puzzle (Net by default), start a new game, rotate tiles, undo, show the solution, read the status line. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/sgt-puzzles
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/sgt-puzzles open_puzzle --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/sgt-puzzles new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/sgt-puzzles tap_tile --device <serial> --param row=<row> --param col=<col>
ghost skill run ghost/sgt-puzzles undo_move --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/sgt-puzzles show_solution --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/sgt-puzzles get_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_puzzle`: Open the Net puzzle
- `new_game`: Start a new Net puzzle
- `tap_tile`: Rotate the centre tile of the Net puzzle
- `undo_move`: Undo my last move in the puzzle
- `show_solution`: Solve the puzzle
- `get_state`: How far along is my puzzle?
